## Findings

This is the `github.com/usememos/memos` Go module. Third-party identity provider (SSO) authentication is implemented across two Go packages:

**1. Abstraction package**
- Path: `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/idp.go`
- Package: `idp` (import path `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`)
- Content: defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the shared/common struct (identifier, display name, email, avatar URL) that any concrete identity-provider protocol implementation returns. This is the "abstraction" — a minimal shared contract that other protocol packages under `internal/idp/` build against (the interface is duck-typed via the `NewIdentityProvider`/`ExchangeToken`/`UserInfo` method convention rather than an explicit Go `interface{}` type — there is currently only one concrete implementation, so no formal `interface` has been extracted yet).

**2. Concrete protocol implementation package**
- Path: `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`
- Package: `oauth2` (import path `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`), doc comment: "Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration."
- Content: `IdentityProvider` struct wrapping a `*storepb.OAuth2Config`, with `NewIdentityProvider(config)`, `ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURL, code, codeVerifier)` (uses `golang.org/x/oauth2`, supports PKCE), and `UserInfo(ctx, token) (*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error)` which calls the provider's userinfo endpoint and maps claims into the `idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` abstraction using configurable field mappings.
- Test file: `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2_test.go`

**Wiring/consumer** (shows the abstraction/implementation relationship in use):
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go` — `resolveSSOIdentity()` switches on `identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2`, constructs `oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(...)`, calls `.ExchangeToken()` then `.UserInfo()`, receiving back `*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo`.

**Related supporting files:**
- `/bench/home/work/proto/gen/store/idp.pb.go` — protobuf-generated `IdentityProviderConfig` (`OAuth2Config`, etc.) and `storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2` enum type used for provider configuration storage (protocol config, not the Go abstraction interface itself).
- `/bench/home/work/server/auth/` — separate package (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`, `context.go`) handling memos' own session/JWT authentication middleware, distinct from third-party IdP integration.
- Frontend counterpart: `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/IdentityProviderButtons.tsx`, `/bench/home/work/web/src/utils/oauth.ts`, `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/CreateIdentityProviderDialog.tsx`, `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/Settings/SSOSection.tsx`.

Currently OAuth2 is the only protocol implemented (no dedicated OIDC or SAML subpackages exist under `internal/idp/`), so `oauth2` is the sole concrete implementation of the `idp` abstraction at this time.</result>
